$schema: VMR QB routing registry - the ONE place the test/ owner, redirects, channels, support destinations and category routing are defined. There is no default owner: a failure that maps to no team says "No identified owner". Repo -> owner, the list of real teams and repo-name handle aliases are NOT here: they are read from the Repo Ownership table in docs/VMR-QB-Guide.md. The report instructions and the docs read from these two sources; do not restate them elsewhere.
verification: Nothing derived from the Guide is listed here. Real teams and repo owners are the Repo Ownership table of docs/VMR-QB-Guide.md, copied to local/knowledge/guide-ownership.json on first use; a repo name used as a handle (@dotnet/runtime) resolves to that repo's owner from the same table (add "handleAliases" or "teams" only for something the Guide lacks). Each key under 'preferredRedirects' IS a real team that routing deliberately narrows to a better audience. People are in the local team-contacts.json. A category names its owners with "ownerRepos" (repos whose owner the Guide gives, so a Guide change reaches the category) and/or "owners" (teams chosen outright).

channels.vmrWide: Unified Build Technical and General Discussions

channelRules.First Responders: HELIX ISSUES ONLY (Helix test execution, Helix queues/machines). Never route 1ES pipeline-template tasks, SBoM/Guardian tooling, NuGet feed auth, credential providers or agent-pool problems there.
channelRules.Unified Build Technical and General Disc: VMR-specific hot issues: all builds broken, a badly stale PR, snap-blocking problems.
channelRules.Servicing chat: Servicing-branch coordination. Do not treat every release branch as preview/RC.

supportDestinations.name: 1ES support
supportDestinations.note: 1ES Pipeline Template task failures (SBoM, Guardian, 1ES PT Run Task, binary analysis)

categories.name: Test timeouts
categories.note: Source-build validation Run Tests timeouts. NOT the 150-minute RepoBuild timeouts: attribute those to the repo whose 'Building <repo>' marker has no matching 'done' line in the timed-out leg's log, never to a repo that merely logged an error in the same file.
